$description: Vistoo design tokens. Calm, neutral, Apple-inspired: one accent colour (blue) for interaction; status colours are always paired with a shape and a text label. Every colour has a light `value` and a `dark` value (dark appearance: web follows the system or the user's choice, iOS/Android follow the system). Edit here, then run `npm run generate` → apps/web/src/app/tokens.generated.css, apps/ios/.../VistooUI/Generated/DesignTokens.swift and apps/android/.../ui/generated/DesignTokens.kt. Platform-specific values go into `overrides` — never change a base value to fix one platform.

brand.description: Logo accent (navy stroke of the V); only for the brand mark

elevated.description: Popovers, menus, dialogs (lifted above the page in dark mode)

status-backlog.description: Backlog icon (dashed circle); text stays neutral

status-open.description: Status icon colour; text stays neutral

base.description: px/pt. Web derives sm/md/lg/xl from --radius; iOS uses the named steps.

spacing.$description: 4-pt grid. Web: Tailwind's spacing scale (1 = 4px) is equivalent; these names are used by iOS.

shadow.$description: `webDark`: web shadows in dark mode (iOS/Android: same parameters, black shadows barely show on dark surfaces).

typography.$description: Semantic roles. Web: compact tool scale (rem). iOS: Dynamic Type text styles (scale with the user's text size); body is deliberately larger on iOS for touch readability. Android: sp sizes equal to the iOS defaults (scale with the system font size).

overrides.$description: Explicit platform overrides. Only the named platform changes.

surface-subtle.reason: Matches iOS grouped list backgrounds (systemGroupedBackground, black in dark mode) so native lists and custom surfaces blend.

lg.reason: Touch-sized cards and buttons read better with slightly rounder corners on iPhone.

surface-subtle.reason: The Android app mirrors the iOS screen layout (grouped lists); same grouped background as iOS so both apps look alike.

lg.reason: Same touch-sized card and button corners as the iOS app.
